history.smell: Same carrier-type conditional chain duplicated across three functions (Strategy-shaped gap); primitive obsession on a raw carrier string instead of a literal union; boolean-parameter trap on isExpress/isFragile; magic-number rate literals scattered per branch.

history.bug: useEffect fetching vitals on patientId change has no guard against out-of-order responses (no cleanup/ignore flag or request-identity check), so a stale fetch for a previously selected patient can resolve after a newer one and silently overwrite the currently displayed patient's vitals - an async race condition that only shows up when requests resolve out of order.
